visual_action: The video is a slideshow of two still images. The first image is of Donald Trump with his eyes closed, mouth open, and a hand to his forehead. The second image is of the Star Wars character Jabba the Hutt.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: A still photo of Donald Trump is the first image shown in the video.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the @democrats account.

spoken_summary: There is no speech in the video.
audio_music: A bombastic, orchestral score plays throughout the video, creating a mock-epic and satirical tone.
central_claim: Donald Trump is visually and metaphorically comparable to the grotesque Star Wars character Jabba the Hutt.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump by comparing him to an unflattering fictional character and to encourage viewers to view him negatively.
uncertainty_flags: The specific piece of orchestral music is not identified but sounds like a film score, possibly from Star Wars.
